title: hieracium pilosella subsp. microcephaloides
intro: Hieracium pilosella subsp. microcephaloides, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is characterized by its small, yellowish flowers and leaves. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and gastrointestinal problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pilosella subsp. microcephaloides include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
